title: Quantization Playbook: FP8/INT8 Staging & Ranking Validation for Reranker
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a reproducible playbook for producing, validating, and staging FP8 and INT8 quantization profiles for the document reranker model. The goal is to define repeatable calibration workflows, required artifacts, statistical acceptance gates (NDCG / MRR), canary rollout steps, and rollback thresholds so quantized variants can be gated for Dedicated and Hosted deployments without regression to ranking quality. This ticket captures the end-to-end plan and initial runs for the first FP8 candidate.
acceptance_criteria: A calibration pipeline that produces deterministic quantization profiles (FP8 and INT8) given a calibration dataset snapshot
Automated evaluation harness that reports NDCG@1/3/10 and MRR along with per-slice deltas and p-values
Defined pass / fail gates: no slice may regress by >0.5 absolute NDCG@10 and global NDCG@10 / MRR regression must be within statistical bounds (95% CI) compared to baseline float32
Canary rollout playbook with traffic split steps and automatic rollback triggers documented
Artifacts (profiles, logs, eval reports) uploaded to shared storage and linked in the ticket
calibration_workflow_steps: Prepare calibration snapshot: dedupe, stratify by query length and feature buckets, sample 20k calibration items
Run per-layer activation collection with deterministic seed; persist fp8/int8 calibration histograms and bias corrections
Apply per-channel symmetric/asymmetric quant scheme as controlled experiment toggles
Generate candidate profile bundle + metadata (model commit, tokenizer hash, dataset hash)
Verify numerics with lightweight unit tests (max absolute error, quantized embedding cosine drift)
Export profile and register artifact in storage with versioned path
evaluation_plan: Evaluation datasets: production-like dev-set (50k queries), held-out regression set (10k queries), and adversarial tail set (5k queries)
Metrics: NDCG@1, NDCG@3, NDCG@10, MRR; also per-query rank swap counts and top-1 swap heatmap
Statistical tests: paired bootstrap for CI on NDCG and MRR; report p-values and bootstrap CIs
Slicing: by query length, intent category, document length, and heavy-token queries to detect per-slice regressions
Pass thresholds: mean NDCG@10 delta >= -0.0005 (i.e., less than 0.05% absolute regression) and MRR delta statistically indistinguishable at alpha=0.05
Minimum sample sizes computed per-slice; require at least 200 queries per slice or mark as low-confidence
canary_rollout_steps: Stage deployment to internal canary (1% user traffic) for 24h with synthetic smoke load
Collect live ranking telemetry and compare offline eval deltas against online signals (CTR surrogate, manual relevance checks)
If online NDCG proxy drifts beyond -0.01 absolute or error rate increases by >2x, trigger automated rollback
Expand traffic to 5% for 48h if stable, then 20% for 72h before full rollout
Ensure fallback path to float32 variant and fast routing in router for immediate switch
rollback_criteria: Global online ranking proxy NDCG drop > 0.01 absolute
Error rate (inference errors or OOMs) increases by >150% vs baseline
SLO breaches (p95 latency > configured SLO) attributable to quantized runtime
Any per-slice NDCG regression > 0.005 absolute on critical customer segments

notes: This playbook emphasizes conservative gates for reranker work because small ranking changes can cascade into large UX differences.
We prefer per-slice statistical tests over single global metrics to catch regressions affecting minority query types.
FP8 experiments must include INT8 fallback candidates for rapid rollback if production regressions appear.
